title: Answer: a brain whose every relevant event has a sufficient physical cause

statements.text: What would count against the view is evidence that neuroscience leaves no room for a mind to act on the brain in the right way: that the neural events behind voluntary action all have sufficient physical causes, or, in the Beck-Eccles form, that synaptic release shows no quantum probability that intention could shift.

sources.quote: simply observe that empirical neuroscience leaves insufficient room for a soul to act on the brain in the right sort of way
